title: Minimum Sum of Values by Dividing Array
summary: Given arrays nums and andValues of lengths n and m, respectively, divide nums into m disjoint contiguous subarrays where the bitwise AND of each subarray equals the corresponding value in andValues.
statement: Given arrays nums and andValues of lengths n and m, respectively, divide nums into m disjoint contiguous subarrays where the bitwise AND of each subarray equals the corresponding value in andValues. Find the minimum sum of the values of these subarrays. If division is impossible, return -1.
constraints: nums and and_values contain nonnegative integers, and the target list is nonempty.
Partition all of nums into exactly len(and_values) nonempty contiguous groups whose bitwise ANDs match the targets in order.
The cost is the sum of each group’s final array element; return the minimum cost or -1 when impossible.
reference_solution:
def minimum_and_partition_sum(nums,and_values):
    from functools import lru_cache
    infinity=10**30;size=len(nums);groups=len(and_values)
    @lru_cache(None)
    def search(index,group,current):
        if size-index<groups-group:return infinity
        if group==groups:return 0 if index==size else infinity
        current&=nums[index]
        if current<and_values[group]:return infinity
        answer=search(index+1,group,current)
        if current==and_values[group]:answer=min(answer,search(index+1,group+1,-1)+nums[index])
        return answer
    answer=search(0,0,-1)
    return -1 if answer>=infinity else answer

hints: While extending a group its AND only loses bits; a group may close exactly when it equals the current target.
Memoize scan index, target group, and running AND; either extend or close and pay the current final value.
Prune when elements left are fewer than groups or running AND is below target; after all groups require all elements consumed.
The recursion enumerates every ordered partition boundary once, and its accumulated endpoint costs match the objective exactly.

tests.explanation: The only feasible four groups end with values four, three, three, and two, whose sum is twelve.
Groups [2,3], [5], and [7,7] have ANDs two, five, and seven, so this target is impossible and returns -1.
